metadata.source: Research compilation — classic historical and literary works
metadata.description: Literary classics and historical fiction works to push entity count past 3,000. Includes major novels, plays, films, and games not yet in the knowledge graph.

figures.name: Miguel de Cervantes
figures.title: Spanish novelist and playwright
figures.description: Author of Don Quixote, considered the first modern novel and one of the greatest works of world literature, also a soldier who lost the use of his left hand at Lepanto

figures.name: Victor Hugo
figures.title: French poet, novelist, and dramatist
figures.description: Author of Les Miserables and The Hunchback of Notre-Dame, France's greatest romantic writer who also served as a senator and champion of the poor

figures.name: Alexandre Dumas
figures.title: French novelist and playwright
figures.description: Author of The Three Musketeers and The Count of Monte Cristo, the most widely read French author in history and grandson of a Haitian slave

figures.name: Chinua Achebe
figures.title: Nigerian novelist and critic
figures.description: Father of modern African literature whose Things Fall Apart challenged colonial narratives and is the most widely read novel from Africa

figures.name: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
figures.title: Colombian novelist and Nobel laureate
figures.description: Master of magical realism whose One Hundred Years of Solitude defined a literary movement and earned the Nobel Prize in Literature

figures.name: Kazuo Ishiguro
figures.title: British novelist and Nobel laureate
figures.description: Nobel Prize-winning author whose novels explore memory, self-deception, and the passage of time, from The Remains of the Day to Never Let Me Go

figures.name: Elie Wiesel
figures.title: Romanian-American writer and Nobel laureate
figures.description: Holocaust survivor whose memoir Night bore witness to the horrors of Auschwitz, becoming the conscience of the Holocaust and winning the Nobel Peace Prize

figures.name: Anne Frank
figures.title: German-Dutch diarist
figures.description: Jewish girl whose diary written while hiding from the Nazis became one of the most widely read books in the world, died in Bergen-Belsen at age 15

figures.name: Art Spiegelman
figures.title: American cartoonist
figures.description: Creator of Maus, the first graphic novel to win a Pulitzer Prize, depicting the Holocaust through the metaphor of cats and mice

figures.name: Marjane Satrapi
figures.title: Iranian-French graphic novelist
figures.description: Author and illustrator of Persepolis, the graphic memoir of growing up during the Iranian Revolution that became an acclaimed animated film

works.title: The Hunchback of Notre-Dame
works.creator: Victor Hugo
works.description: Gothic novel set in medieval Paris about the deformed bell-ringer Quasimodo, the beautiful Esmeralda, and the corrupt Archdeacon Frollo

works.title: A Tale of Two Cities
works.creator: Charles Dickens
works.description: Novel of the French Revolution following characters between London and Paris, the best-selling novel of all time with over 200 million copies

works.title: The Scarlet Letter
works.creator: Nathaniel Hawthorne
works.description: Novel about sin, guilt, and redemption in Puritan Massachusetts, following Hester Prynne as she bears the shame of an adultery conviction

works.title: Moby-Dick
works.creator: Herman Melville
works.description: Epic novel of Captain Ahab's obsessive pursuit of the white whale, a masterwork of American literature blending adventure, philosophy, and cetology

works.title: The Great Gatsby
works.creator: F. Scott Fitzgerald
works.description: Quintessential Jazz Age novel about the mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby's doomed pursuit of the American Dream and his lost love Daisy Buchanan

works.title: The Grapes of Wrath
works.creator: John Steinbeck
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning novel following the Joad family's migration from Dust Bowl Oklahoma to California, a searing portrait of the Great Depression

works.title: Pride and Prejudice
works.creator: Jane Austen
works.description: Perhaps the most beloved English novel, following Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy through the social politics of Regency England

works.title: Jane Eyre
works.creator: Charlotte Bronte
works.description: Gothic novel about an orphan governess who falls in love with the brooding Mr. Rochester, pioneering the exploration of female independence and desire

works.title: Wuthering Heights
works.creator: Emily Bronte
works.description: Wild tale of obsessive love and revenge on the Yorkshire moors, following the destructive passion between Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw

works.title: Frankenstein
works.creator: Mary Shelley
works.description: The first science fiction novel, about a scientist who creates a living being and the tragic consequences, written by an 18-year-old woman during the Year Without a Summer

works.title: Crime and Punishment
works.creator: Fyodor Dostoevsky
works.description: Psychological novel about a poor student who murders a pawnbroker and the moral crisis that follows, a cornerstone of existentialist literature

works.title: The Odyssey
works.creator: Homer
works.description: Ancient Greek epic poem following Odysseus's ten-year journey home from the Trojan War, encountering monsters, gods, and temptations

works.title: The Iliad
works.creator: Homer
works.description: The foundational work of Western literature, depicting the climactic weeks of the Trojan War through the wrath of Achilles

works.title: The Aeneid
works.creator: Virgil
works.description: Roman national epic following the Trojan hero Aeneas from the fall of Troy to the founding of Rome, rivaling Homer in literary influence

works.title: Beowulf
works.creator: Anonymous
works.description: The oldest surviving long poem in Old English, following the Geatish warrior Beowulf as he battles the monster Grendel and a dragon

works.title: The Divine Comedy
works.creator: Dante Alighieri
works.description: Italian epic poem describing the author's journey through Hell, Purgatory, and Paradise, the supreme expression of medieval European thought

works.title: The Canterbury Tales
works.creator: Geoffrey Chaucer
works.description: Collection of stories told by pilgrims traveling to Canterbury, a vivid panorama of 14th-century English society from knight to miller to wife of Bath

works.title: One Thousand and One Nights
works.creator: Various
works.description: Collection of Middle Eastern folk tales including Aladdin, Ali Baba, and Sinbad, framed by Scheherazade's nightly storytelling to save her life

works.title: The Mahabharata
works.creator: Vyasa
works.description: The longest epic poem ever written, over 200,000 verses chronicling the great war between the Pandava and Kaurava families in ancient India

works.title: The Decameron
works.creator: Giovanni Boccaccio
works.description: Collection of 100 tales told by ten young people sheltering from the Black Death in Florence, a masterwork of Italian prose and ribald humor

works.title: The Decameron (TV series)
works.creator: Kathleen Jordan
works.description: Netflix dark comedy reimagining Boccaccio's classic with nobles and servants trapped together during the plague in a lavish Italian villa

works.title: Samurai Marathon
works.creator: Bernard Rose
works.description: Historical action film about a feudal lord who organizes a marathon among his samurai after learning of the approach of Commodore Perry's Black Ships

works.title: The Power of the Dog
works.creator: Jane Campion
works.description: Psychological Western drama about a charismatic rancher whose cruelty threatens the gentle widow and her son who have joined his household in 1920s Montana

works.title: The Northman
works.creator: Robert Eggers
works.description: Viking revenge epic based on the legend of Amleth, the source material for Shakespeare's Hamlet

works.title: Women Talking
works.creator: Sarah Polley
works.description: Drama about women in an isolated religious colony who meet secretly to discuss their response to systematic abuse, based on a true story in a Mennonite colony

works.title: Ammonite
works.creator: Francis Lee
works.description: Period drama imagining a romantic relationship between fossil hunter Mary Anning and a young woman sent to convalesce at the seaside

works.title: Miss Saigon
works.creator: Claude-Michel Schonberg
works.description: Musical retelling of Madame Butterfly set during the Vietnam War and the fall of Saigon, one of the longest-running shows in West End and Broadway history

works.title: Hamilton
works.creator: Lin-Manuel Miranda
works.description: Revolutionary hip-hop musical about the life of Founding Father Alexander Hamilton, using diverse casting to tell America's origin story

works.title: Les Miserables (musical)
works.creator: Claude-Michel Schonberg
works.description: The world's longest-running musical, based on Victor Hugo's novel of redemption and revolution in 19th-century France

works.title: The Phantom of the Opera
works.creator: Andrew Lloyd Webber
works.description: The longest-running show in Broadway history about a disfigured musical genius beneath the Paris Opera House who becomes obsessed with a soprano

works.title: Evita
works.creator: Andrew Lloyd Webber
works.description: Rock opera chronicling the rise of Eva Peron from poverty to First Lady of Argentina and beloved icon of the descamisados

works.title: Sweeney Todd
works.creator: Stephen Sondheim
works.description: Dark musical thriller about the demon barber of Fleet Street who murders his customers while his accomplice bakes them into meat pies

works.title: Fiddler on the Roof
works.creator: Jerry Bock
works.description: Musical about Tevye the dairyman and his daughters in a Russian Jewish village facing the upheaval of tradition, love, and pogroms

works.title: The Crucible
works.creator: Arthur Miller
works.description: Drama about the Salem witch trials used as an allegory for McCarthyism, exploring mass hysteria, power, and the courage to refuse false confession

works.title: A Man for All Seasons
works.creator: Robert Bolt
works.description: Drama about Sir Thomas More's principled refusal to endorse Henry VIII's break with Rome, ultimately choosing death over compromise of conscience

works.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Are Dead
works.creator: Tom Stoppard
works.description: Absurdist tragicomedy retelling Hamlet from the perspective of two minor characters, trapped in a play they cannot understand

works.title: Julius Caesar
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Shakespeare's political tragedy about the assassination of Julius Caesar and its bloody aftermath, exploring power, idealism, and mob mentality

works.title: Antony and Cleopatra
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Shakespeare's sweeping tragedy of the doomed love between the Roman general Mark Antony and the Egyptian queen Cleopatra

works.title: Henry V
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Shakespeare's patriotic history play following Prince Hal's transformation into the warrior king who defeats France at the Battle of Agincourt

works.title: Richard III
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Shakespeare's portrait of the ultimate villain-king, charting Richard's ruthless path to the English throne through manipulation and murder

works.title: Macbeth
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Shakespeare's darkest tragedy about a Scottish lord driven to regicide by ambition and prophecy, spiraling into madness and tyranny

works.title: Othello
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Tragedy of the Moorish general Othello whose jealousy, manipulated by the villainous Iago, leads him to murder his innocent wife Desdemona

works.title: Hamlet
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: The greatest play ever written — the Prince of Denmark's struggle with revenge, mortality, and the corruption of power after his father's ghost demands justice

works.title: The Tempest
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Shakespeare's final masterpiece about the exiled sorcerer Prospero who conjures a storm to bring his enemies to his island, exploring colonialism and forgiveness

works.title: King Lear
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Devastating tragedy of an aging king who divides his kingdom among his daughters and descends into madness when betrayed by two of them

works.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Enchanting comedy about lovers, fairies, and bumbling amateur actors in an Athenian forest where magic and mischief reign

works.title: Romeo and Juliet
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: The world's most famous love story — two teenagers from feuding families fall in love and their deaths ultimately reconcile their warring parents

works.title: The Merchant of Venice
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Controversial comedy-drama about the moneylender Shylock who demands a pound of flesh as collateral, exploring justice, mercy, and antisemitism

works.title: Twelfth Night
works.creator: William Shakespeare
works.description: Romantic comedy of mistaken identity featuring the shipwrecked Viola disguised as a man, creating a tangle of unrequited love

properties.notes: Cervantes is the author of Don Quixote
Victor Hugo is the author of Les Miserables
Alexandre Dumas is the author of The Count of Monte Cristo
Alexandre Dumas is the author of The Three Musketeers
